title: Top Gaming Laptops Under $1500 (2026)
summary: The ROG Strix G16 leads on performance under $1500, with the ASUS TUF Gaming, Acer Nitro V 16 and Lenovo LOQ 15 as the value picks.
method: Picks come from Notebookcheck, PCGuide, Eneba, GeekChamp, Empire and two smaller testing roundups. Only models or lines named by at least two of these sources are listed.
assumptions: We show no prices because gaming-laptop prices and configurations change often. GPU wattage, RAM and cooling vary a lot between versions, so check the exact configuration before you buy.

products.name: ASUS ROG Strix G16
why: Eneba and two other review roundups name the ROG Strix G16 the best overall gaming laptop under $1500, and PCGuide calls it the best 16-inch pick in this budget.
One roundup lists an RTX 5060 with DLSS 4 and says it holds steady performance without throttling, though it can run hot under heavy load.
pros: Strongest all-round performance in the group
cons: Under 2 hours of gaming on battery (review roundup)
products.best_for: Gamers who want the best performance under $1500
products.skip_if: You want a thin, light laptop with long battery life
products.amazon_listing: ASUS ROG Strix G16 (2025) Gaming Laptop, 16” ROG Nebula 16:10 2.5K 240Hz/3ms, NVIDIA® GeFo

products.name: ASUS TUF Gaming A16 / A18 / F16
why: Notebookcheck ranks the TUF Gaming A18 with a Ryzen 7 260 and RTX 5060 second on its affordable gaming laptop list. Eneba calls the TUF Gaming A16 its pick for high performance under $1500.
Other roundups praise the TUF Gaming F16 as the most durable build and the budget champion of the group.
specs: AMD Ryzen 7 260 and RTX 5060 in the A18 (Notebookcheck)
pros: Stays comfortable to the touch during long sessions (review roundup)
products.best_for: Gamers who want a tough, good-value laptop
products.skip_if: You want a premium thin design
products.amazon_listing: ASUS TUF Gaming F16 Gaming Laptop, 16” FHD+ 144Hz IPS-Level 16:10 Display, Intel® Core™ 5

products.name: Acer Nitro V 16 / 16S AI
why: Eneba names the Nitro V 16 its best gaming laptop for 1080p under $1500. A July roundup picks the Nitro V 16S AI as its best value, with a 32GB option for gamers who also stream.
Notebookcheck also lists the Nitro V 16 AI among its good affordable gaming laptops.
cons: Typical gaming-laptop battery life of about 3 hours of casual use (review roundup)
products.skip_if: You want the most premium build

products.name: Lenovo LOQ 15
why: Notebookcheck lists the 2026 Lenovo LOQ 15 as a good affordable gaming laptop. GeekChamp's top overall pick under $1000 is a discounted LOQ with an RTX 4060.
Empire calls the LOQ 15 the best 15-inch gaming laptop in its budget range.
cons: Best value only on discounted RTX 4060 versions
products.best_for: Players who want to spend less than the premium options
products.skip_if: You want the strongest GPU at this price
